what the definition says that CCA's read: links' accessible names; names of elements made controls by a click handler; UI-library field components' label property; that a legend is non-empty
pointer-cursor elements; mouse-only bindings; placeholder-destination links acting as buttons
a replacement focus style; colours in in-repo .css files, tokens and utility classes (reading sees inline styles and in-repo CSS literals)
web-framework types (for example ASP.NET) are not among the infrastructure types the reading checks
members that only throw a not-implemented error are not among the shapes the reading lists
tools invoked only in CI workflows; the reading inspects package.json scripts only
reproducibility of the build beyond dependency pinning; the reading checks only that a lockfile or central package management is present
outside .NET the reading counts only named async functions that themselves make a request a signal can cancel, not every async function
outside C#, string operations other than an extraction regex encoding a JSON key or XML tag (replace, split, slicing)
implications other than string-literal containment on the same side-effect-free value under the same test, or nested numeric bounds
boolean expressions that are not a logical and/or chain
earlier arms that subsume a later one other than by a containment test on a literal
loops that shorten the string by more than its last character per pass
side effects the guard's own operators cannot skip, and side effects other than an increment, decrement or assignment
security headers outside its six-header baseline (for example Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy)
WCAG success criteria that a static reading can also reach (it audits only those the static pass cannot)
undeclared ports that are opened but not published to the host (it calls out only published ports)
frontend code in languages other than JavaScript and TypeScript
repeated boolean expressions that contain no string literal or no call
asynchronous methods whose signature a framework fixes (overrides, UI event handlers, route and lifecycle exports, request handlers) are not counted
flags held outside a local variable (fields, captured or parameter flags), and returns whose value is not a literal
nullable context enabled per file or per region by a `#nullable` directive
outside C#, hand-parsing of one format where only a parser for the other format is referenced (the reading matches by format)
the one existing reading also requires the expression to contain a string literal and a call (a narrowing filter of the reading, not part of the definition)
(reverse) CCA's reading also reports range guards whose bound rejects every value or admits an index one past the end; the definition does not name them
